rows: NEET UG scores are used for admission. Counselling rules and eligibility marks change, so read the notice for your year.
Income comes from a practice built patient by patient, so there is no quick high salary. Training is long and the entry race is the same one MBBS faces.
NEET UG scores are used for admission under the veterinary council's rules.
Income comes from a clinic or a farm-health service built one client at a time. Check the posts and clinics near you before you plan on it.
No NEET. Entry is by marks or a university test, so read each prospectus.
Early pay is modest. A private practice or programme can grow, but it needs credibility, advice within your qualification and a way to find clients.
No NEET. Entry is by marks or a university test.
A hospital job is a fixed ladder. An eye-care or optical shop with repeat customers is the business layer, and it needs local licence checks and capital.
No NEET. Class 12 with PCB at most colleges.

No NEET. Subject rules differ by college, so read the prospectus.
Client work needs further study and the right professional registration, and trust takes time to build. Check the current requirement before you plan on it.
Look only at the cheapest approved seats. A loan for a private course would be far out of line with the pay samples above.
